newsitem.title: USA: Ameritech pegs Americast share at 28 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ameritech pegs Americast share at 28 pct.

text.p: Ameritech Corp said Wednesday its Americast cable television service has beat the company's expectations with a 28 percent market share average in its service area.
"We view ourselves as very successful," chairman and chief executive Richard Notebaert told reporters after the company's annual shareholder meeting. "We haven't stuttered even once."
Ameritech now has 34 cable franchise agreements in its five-state area and offers the service in 22 communities in Illinois, Michigan and Ohio.
Notebaert said on average the market share in those areas is 28 percent.

Ameritech said it continues to aggressively pursue other franchise agreements and prepare for service in other areas. The company estimates Americast will be available to about 1.5 million homes in its region by the end of the year.
Ameritech is a regional Bell company and provides telephone, cellular, paging, security monitoring, cable TV and online services.

Americast is a programming venture comprising Ameritech, BellSouth Corp, GTE Corp, SBC Communications Inc, Southern New England Telecommunications Corp and Walt Disney Co. It began formal operations in late 1995.
